item.title: 28 Year Later: The Bone Temple
item.description: I am in awe at the post-post-apocalyptic world that DANNY BOYLE, ALEX GARLAND, and director NIA DACOSTA have created here. The post 28 Year Later: The Bone Temple appeared first on David Moody.

item.title: Targets
item.description: TARGETS is a fascinating, though not entirely successful 1968 movie which stars BORIS KARLOFF in one of his final screen appearances. The post Targets appeared first on David Moody.

item.title: Sunshine
item.description: Of all Danny Boyle's lesser known films, though, I think SUNSHINE is one that warrants being spoken about alongside his best. The post Sunshine appeared first on David Moody.

item.title: Kayak
item.description: My friend KRISTAL STITTLE just released a new novel, and it's a cracker. KAYAK is a fresh vision of the apocalypse that I really enjoyed. The post Kayak appeared first on David Moody.

item.title: What a stupid career choice
item.description: Have you ever stopped to think about how ridiculous it is trying to make a living as an author? It's not the most sensible career. The post What a stupid career choice appeared first on David Moody.

item.title: We Bury the Dead
